attrs.InputOwnedSteeringTurnBankNotes: Raw left/right input remains the sole bank owner. SteeringDriveMode restores original reverse yaw, retains forward mode while braking, and switches to forward immediately on forward throttle during a three-point turn.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostNotes: When DriftMiniBoostRequiresAcceleration is true, releasing drift only grants mini-boost if throttle is above DriftMiniBoostAccelerationThreshold. ReverseMaxMph controls reverse top speed.
attrs.AccelBrakeTiltNotes: Positive/negative pitch direction may depend on the live vehicle orientation. If acceleration or braking tilts the wrong way, flip the sign of the matching degrees value.
attrs.SpeedSteeringNotes: LowMultiplier boosts low-speed turning, HighMultiplier softens high-speed turning, CurveExponent controls how aggressively low-speed assist ramps in, ReverseSteeringMultiplier tunes reverse separately, BoostSteeringMultiplier stacks on top while normal boost or drift mini-boost is active.
attrs.SlopeHoverNotes: Fixes uphill/downhill hover-height drift by damping vertical velocity relative to expected slope-following vertical motion instead of raw world-Y velocity. ForceAlongGroundNormal is optional and off by default.

Vehicles.value: false

attrs.DriftTuningNote: DriftGrip reduces boat-like slide; EngineAssist and VelocityAlignment pull momentum around the corner; SideForce creates rotation.
attrs.AccelerationTuningNote: Launch* controls 0-14 MPH; PowerBand* controls where tiered pull fades; AerodynamicDrag* controls high-speed resistance.
attrs.BoostTuningNote: Duration/Recharge min/max seconds are physical bounds; raw V2 boost stats still determine position within them.
attrs.OrganisedTuningNote: Select one category Folder and edit its numeric Attributes. Each matching _RaisingThisDoes string explains the higher-value effect.
attrs.TuningNote: Phase 1 longitudinal dynamics. Disable Enabled for immediate legacy-force rollback.
attrs.HandlingTuningNote: SteeringResponse min/max multipliers compress E-S steering without changing rating stats.

attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedMinMph_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the lowest physical top speed the curve can produce.
attrs.WeightAccelerationMaxMultiplier_RaisingT: Improves the best acceleration multiplier for light vehicles.
attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens tier speed differences: below-reference vehicles become slower and above-reference vehicles become faster.
attrs.HighSpeedAccelerationExponent_RaisingThi: Makes acceleration fall away more sharply after the power band.
attrs.HighSpeedAccelerationFloor_RaisingThisDo: Leaves more engine pull available very near top speed.
attrs.EngineOutputReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more EngineOutput to reach the reference acceleration multiplier.
attrs.LaunchRampEndMph_RaisingThisDoes: Extends the softer launch section to a higher speed.
attrs.WeightAccelerationMinMultiplier_RaisingT: Improves the worst acceleration multiplier for heavy vehicles.
attrs.DragReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires a higher Drag stat to reach the neutral air-resistance point.
attrs.EngineOutputExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens acceleration differences between weak and powerful engines.
attrs.BaseForwardAcceleration_RaisingThisDoes: Increases forward acceleration across the speed range.
attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the normal configurable ceiling for mapped physical top speed.
attrs.AbsoluteTopSpeedSafetyMph_RaisingThisDoe: Raises the final safety ceiling, but only when PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph is also high enough.
attrs.PowerBandStartRatioLow_RaisingThisDoes: Lets low-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.
attrs.AerodynamicDragStatExponent_RaisingThisD: Makes the vehicle Drag stat influence air resistance more strongly.
attrs.PowerBandStartRatioHigh_RaisingThisDoes: Lets high-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.
attrs.LaunchEngineInfluence_RaisingThisDoes: Makes engine-power differences more noticeable during launch.
attrs.EngineOutputMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe: Raises the maximum acceleration available to high-power vehicles.
attrs.WeightAccelerationExponent_RaisingThisDo: Makes vehicle weight affect acceleration more strongly.
attrs.SoftLimiterStrength_RaisingThisDoes: Pushes the vehicle back under its forward or reverse speed limit more strongly.
attrs.EngineOutputMinMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe: Raises the minimum acceleration available to low-power vehicles.
attrs.TopSpeedRawReference_RaisingThisDoes: Reduces mapped physical speed for the same raw TopSpeed stat.
attrs.WeightReference_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the weight point that counts as neutral for acceleration and braking.
attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedAtReferenceMph_RaisingTh: Raises the physical top speed of every vehicle around the reference stat.
attrs.LaunchAccelerationMultiplier_RaisingThis: Makes the initial launch below the ramp speed stronger.
attrs.AerodynamicDragPerMphSquared_RaisingThis: Adds more speed-squared air resistance at high speed.

attrs.SteeringResponseMinMultiplier_RaisingThi: Improves the minimum steering available to low-stat vehicles.
attrs.SteeringWeightMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisD: Improves the best steering multiplier for light vehicles.
attrs.SteeringResponseMaxMultiplier_RaisingThi: Raises the maximum steering available to high-stat vehicles.
attrs.SteeringResponseExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens the steering difference between low- and high-stat vehicles.
attrs.SteeringWeightMinMultiplier_RaisingThisD: Improves the worst steering multiplier for heavy vehicles.
attrs.SteeringWeightInfluenceExponent_RaisingT: Makes weight influence steering and drift control more strongly.
attrs.SteeringResponseReference_RaisingThisDoe: Requires more SteeringResponse stat to reach neutral steering.
attrs.BasePhysicalSteeringResponse_RaisingThis: Makes every vehicle turn more quickly.

attrs.DriftMiniBoostChargeForFullReward_Raisin: Requires a longer or faster-charging drift to reach the full reward.
attrs.PhysicalDriftControlMaxMultiplier_Raisin: Raises maximum drift control on high-stat vehicles.
attrs.PhysicalDriftControlExponent_RaisingThis: Widens physical drift-control differences between vehicle stats.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostMaxAcceleration_RaisingThi: Makes a fully charged reference post-drift boost accelerate harder.
attrs.DriftGripReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more DriftGrip stat to reach neutral drift grip.
attrs.DriftControlReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more DriftControl stat to reach neutral drift authority.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceMinMultiplier_Ra: Raises the post-drift power floor for low-force boost modules.
attrs.BaseDriftLateralGrip_RaisingThisDoes: Adds drift grip and reduces boat-like sideways sliding.
attrs.DriftForwardDragBase_RaisingThisDoes: Removes more forward speed throughout a drift.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMaxMultiplier: Raises the duration multiplier ceiling for high-duration boost modules.
attrs.DriftControlExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes DriftControl affect turning and alignment more strongly.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationReferenceSeco: Requires a higher mapped BoostDuration to reach the neutral duration multiplier.
attrs.BaseDriftSideForce_RaisingThisDoes: Adds more sideways turning force while drifting.
attrs.DriftGripExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the DriftGrip stat affect remaining slide more strongly.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostAbsoluteMaxDurationSeconds: Raises the final safety cap for post-drift boost duration.
attrs.PhysicalDriftControlMinMultiplier_Raisin: Improves minimum drift control on low-stat vehicles.
attrs.BasePhysicalDriftControl_RaisingThisDoes: Increases the baseline drift turning authority for every vehicle.
attrs.DriftChargeExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes DriftChargeRate change drift-charge speed more strongly.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBaseMaxDurationSeconds_Rai: Makes a fully charged reference post-drift boost last longer before stat scaling.
attrs.DriftVelocityAlignmentMaxAcceleration_Ra: Allows a stronger maximum momentum-alignment force during a drift.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostAbsoluteMinDurationSeconds: Raises the absolute shortest post-drift boost duration.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationExponent_Rais: Widens post-drift duration differences between low- and high-duration boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostForceApplicationMultiplier: Raises the final physical force applied by every post-drift boost.
attrs.DriftChargeReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more DriftChargeRate to reach neutral drift-charge speed.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostRewardExponent_RaisingThis: Makes partially charged drifts produce less duration and force.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMinMultiplier: Raises the duration floor for low-duration boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceExponent_Raising: Widens post-drift power differences between low- and high-force boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceMaxMultiplier_Ra: Raises the post-drift power multiplier ceiling for high-force boost modules.
attrs.DriftEngineAssist_RaisingThisDoes: Adds more forward engine drive while acceleration is held in a drift.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostExpiresDuringNormalBoost_R: Makes the post-drift reward expire instead of queueing behind normal boost when raised to 1.

attrs.DriftMiniBoostBaseMinDurationSeconds_Rai: Makes the shortest charge-based post-drift boost last longer.
